column1: # test-p2 cadence-shard: owner bug 10 (the summaries writer didn't wake on schedule; fixed in 9eaa6f4), put back one
# change at a time. Each cadence-9eaa6f4-* row restores the exact pre-9eaa6f4 code; the last four rows are other realistic
# writer-wake bugs the verifier added. owner-writer-cadence must FAIL (CAUGHT) for every row.
# Format (runner-1001/mutate.sh): tab-separated bug, step, file, old, new, note; in old/new, \n is a newline, \t a tab
# and \\ a backslash; old occurs exactly once in file. The note names the FAIL lines that catch the row.

column6: owner bug 10, 9eaa6f4's first change put back: after a pass, any due summary (a rewrite too) arms the tick's one-second wake. Caught by FAIL AC (shipped, every clause refused): the day passes the cadence oracle (an ordinary timer 1 s after a pass, the 0.1.6 failure).

owner bug 10, 9eaa6f4's second change put back: discovery no longer tells rewrites apart, so both one-second wakes fire for a rewrite. Caught by FAIL AC (shipped, every clause refused) and the owner day's look-back, plug-in and whole-day oracle lines.

owner bug 10, 9eaa6f4's third change put back: source discovery (rows landing) arms the one-second service wake for any due summary, a rewrite too. Caught by FAIL owner day (bug 10): a quick look back at a moment already written ... (Jordan's reply and the pull request's checks), and its plug-in and whole-day oracle lines.

other realistic bug 10 shape (verifier, test-p2 cadence-shard): the writer's longest quiet wait becomes an hour, so after an unlock or a wake it looks only hourly. Caught by FAIL owner day (bug 10): after unlocking the screen ... (first look 903 s after it) and FAIL owner day (bug 10): after a lid-close sleep ... (next wake 3600 s after its look).

other realistic bug (verifier, the 9/26 lock class): a screen lock no longer closes the moments before it, only a sleep does. Caught by FAIL owner day (bug 10): the cadence oracle proves every run, timer and wake all day ... (unproved deadline below ordinary floor after the lock).

other realistic bug (verifier): rows landing never arm the writer's service wake, so first notes wait for the ordinary timer. Caught only by the owner day's fixture guard: FAIL owner day (bug 10): a quick look back at a moment already written ... (fixture: the writer never looked while only a rewrite was due).

other realistic bug 10 shape (verifier): after a relaunch the offline model check looks for the release-size model file, so summaries stay off and the writer never wakes again. Caught by FAIL writer-cadence: the reopened writer did not turn back on (the owner day's quit and reopen).
